checkRuns.command: bun run build 2>&1 | tail -20; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2; cat /tmp/kay.log

pkill -f "kay start"; sleep 1
cat > kay.config.ts <<'EOF'
import process from 'node:process'
import { defineConfig } from 'kay/server'

export default defineConfig({
  lang: 'en',
  site: process.env.SITE_URL ?? process.env.ORIGIN,
  seo: { name: 'Bookshelf', titleTemplate: '%s | Bookshelf', description: 'A small catalog of classic books.' },
})
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i "warn\|error" ; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2; cat /tmp/kay.log; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/about | grep -o '<link rel="canonical"[^>]*>'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -H 'Referer: http://localhost:4701/contact' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4701' --data-urlencode 'name=  ' http://127.0.0.1:4701/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/send

cat > kay.config.ts <<'EOF'
import process from 'node:process'
import { defineConfig } from 'kay/server'

export default defineConfig({
  lang: 'en',
  site: process.env.SITE_URL ?? process.env.ORIGIN,
  seo: { name: 'Bookshelf', titleTemplate: '%s | Bookshelf', description: 'A small catalog of classic books.' },
})
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i "warn\|error"; echo build=$?

cat > src/server.ts <<'EOF'
import process from 'node:process'
import { Elysia } from 'elysia'
import { pages } from 'kay/server'

// Exported for `kay check`, which checks links against the routes it serves besides the pages and types `ctx.locals` from its plugins.
export const app = new Elysia().use(await pages()).listen({
  port: Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000),
  hostname: process.env.HOST ?? '0.0.0.0',
})
EOF
grep -n -A12 "^### Style a component\|^### Global" docs/llms/styles-and-assets.md | head -40
